metadata.title: Clicked like a confused raccoon and somehow scored that 1 kill? Valorant what magic is this?
metadata.description:
Me: panic clicking like I’m allergic to aiming
Enemy: probably uninstalling to rethink life choices
Valorant just handed me a kill like it’s charity
Click if your aim’s a mystery too!

Tap if your best kills come from pure chaos!
